CutScene.Text: The Orkish invasion had been quelled. What was more disturbing than the attack itself though, was the way the Orcs had looted the Libraries.
Ordinarily, a book was nothing more to these creatures than a piece of kindling, so the question remained… Why would Orcs do such a thing?
A quick examination of the battlefield, soon showed a reason for this strange behavior – they had been led by Daemons… And Daemons always have a sinister purpose.
